# ResuFlex

> ResuFlex is a free, browser-based resume builder. Every section can be split side by side or stacked and resized by dragging dividers (with snapping to 25/33/50/66/75%). A + button inside each section adds labels, paragraphs and bullet lists, and a formatting toolbar applies bold, italic, underline, bulleted and numbered lists, alignment, font family and size. Resumes export to PDF (via the browser's print dialog) and DOCX. No account; data is stored in the user's browser.

## Key facts
- Price: free, no sign-up
- Storage: browser local storage on the user's device; nothing is uploaded
- Exports: PDF (print dialog), DOCX
- Layout tools: split side by side / stacked, drag or arrow-key resize, ratio presets 25/75 to 75/25, min/max size per section
- Section types: Header, Summary, Experience, Skills, Education, Projects, Custom

## How to use
1. Click a section on the resume page to select it.
2. Split it side by side or stacked in the Properties panel; drag dividers to resize.
3. Click + inside a section to add a Label, Paragraph or Bullet list.
4. Click into text to open the formatting toolbar.
5. Export with PDF or DOCX.
